messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] queue_gpus_pending > 300 on us-west2-gpu-pool (threshold 80) — preempt rate spike detected
Maria: ack, paging eng-sre oncall
Alex: I'm on it, grabbing logs + metrics
Maria: severity P1, customer-facing latency spike on embeddings & chat gen; multiple tenants seeing 429s
Samir: I'm seeing repeated spot preemptions from cloud: ~60% of nodes reclaimed in last 8m
Ciara: autoscaler events show scale-up attempts but hitting maxNodes=120, current=120
Alex: confirming pods in Pending due to insufficient GPUs; queue backlog growing
Alex: run: kubectl get po -n inference | grep Pending
Alex: ```
NAME                                  READY STATUS   RESTARTS AGE
model-infer-xyz-0                      0/1   Pending     0      7m
model-infer-abc-12                     0/1   Pending     0      6m
... (150 pending)
```
Samir: cluster-autoscaler logs: "scale-up aborted: max nodes reached"
Maria: customer impact: real-time chat degraded for ~14 customers, batch embed jobs delayed >10m
Ryan: suggestion: trigger fallback to dedicated pool and temporarily disable spot usage for critical routes
Nadia: can we increase autoscaler max to 200? that'll buy headroom but takes time to spin up nodes
Ciara: cold-start for new GPUs ~4-6m; creating a new nodepool ~6-8m
Alex: quick mitigation steps: 1) prefer routing to us-east1/eu nodes for chat endpoints, 2) pause non-critical batch jobs, 3) bump autoscaler max to 200 and force nodepool resize
Samir: executing nodepool resize now — calling cloud CLI
Samir: ```
cloud compute node-pools resize --cluster=gpu-cluster --node-pool=dense-gpu --size=200 --zone=us-west2
```
incident-bot: runbook gpu-exhaustion -> oncall-handoff triggered
Maria: handoff to next oncall in 30m if unresolved
Ciara: also enabling fast-fallback: remove spot taint from critical deployments so they can schedule on on-demand nodes
Ciara: ```
kubectl patch deployment critical-infer -n inference --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/spec/tolerations/0"}]'
```
Alex: patch applied, pods will schedule onto on-demand nodes as soon as nodes are provisioned
Ryan: quotas check — we have quota for ~80 more GPUs in region; ops/finance looped to request extra if needed
Nadia: we should also lower maxSurge for canary rollouts to avoid extra pod pressure during recovery
Samir: cloud API returned success; nodepool resize accepted and nodes are starting
Alex: monitoring: queue length dropping from 320 -> 180 over the last 2m
Maria: keep customer comms updated — posting to status page: degraded inference latency in US-WEST due to GPU pool interruptions
Maria: draft status: "We are experiencing degraded inference latency in US-WEST due to GPU pool interruptions; we are actively scaling fallback capacity and routing traffic. No data loss. ETA to restore <15m." ok to post? :thumbsup:
Alex: :thumbsup:
Ryan: after-action items: (1) increase autoscaler ceiling for spot-heavy pools, (2) add predictive buffer 20% for peak windows, (3) update runbook with fast-fallback commands, (4) postmortem owner Maria
Maria: assigning postmortem to Maria
Maria: handoff note: next oncall please continue monitoring until queue <20 and preempt rate <5% per 10m
Ciara: noted, taking next 30m watch
incident-bot: RESOLVED: queue_gpus_pending dropped below threshold at 2510005620 (check: queue=18)
Maria: closing incident once follow-ups created in Jira
Alex: creating Jira MC-4521 with action items
Alex: ```
Jira link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MC-4521
```
